branch.settings.reservation.title: Appointment Settings
branch.settings.reservation.content: Operation settings for the appointment system
branch.settings.outside_flg.title: Outside table reservations are available
branch.settings.outside_flg.content: Allows you to choose between inside or outside the restaurant when making an appointment. If disabled, the default is inside the restaurant.
branch.settings.max_number_client_reserv: Maximum number of requests that can be accepted
Appointment requests must be pending approval
Customer requests will have to wait for confirmation from the business. If disabled, appointment requests will be automatically approved immediately.
branch.settings.max_number_reservable_da: Maximum number of days allowed for appointments
branch.settings.restaurant_full_by_shift: Limit the number of appointment requests per shift
Maximum number of appointment requests calculated per shift. If disabled, it will be calculated on a per-time basis.
branch.settings.restaurant_meal_duration: Estimated time for an appointment request
branch.settings.client.title: Customer Information Settings
branch.settings.store_client_info_flg.co: Customer information that has requested an appointment will be stored
branch.settings.require_client_phone_flg: Require Phone Number when making an appointment
branch.settings.confirm_client_phone_flg: OTP code will be sent for verification
branch.settings.send_feedback_flg.title: Send email to receive Customer review
branch.settings.send_feedback_flg.conten: After 16-24 hours, the review link will be automatically sent to the Customer's email. Please enter the Google Review link below.
